about: The deposit block of a client’s own booking with a deposit (depositAmount > 0), read by BOTH test suites: web tests and mobile test/unit/deposit_state_test.dart. docs/design/appointment-detail-complete.md §2.7, decision 197. A booking with no deposit shows no block at all.

fields.label: the row’s label
fields.sentence: the line under it, or null
fields.action: send (app: « Envoyer l’acompte »; web: the proof form) · viewProof (« Voir ma capture ») · null
fields.balance: whether « Solde à régler au salon » shows: only while the booking is pending or confirmed
